description: The immutable automatic lifecycle behavior applied to this session.

idleSuspendAfterSeconds.description: Idle sessions automatically suspend after exactly three minutes.

maximumLifetimeSeconds.description: The provider generation expires exactly eight hours after `launchedAt`.

resumeOnLiveFileAccess.description: A live-file request automatically resumes this same suspended generation.

resumeOnMessage.description: A message automatically resumes this same suspended generation.
